vm_name.description: Name of the new guest virtual machine instance

vm_memory.description: Memory to allocate for the guest, in MiB

vm_vcpus.description: Number of virtual cpus to configure for the guest

os_info.description: OS short-id from libosinfo (e.g., fedora32, win10, debian11)

install_source.description: Type of installation source: location, cdrom, or import

install_source_url.description: URL for the distribution tree installation source (used when install_source is 'location')

install_source_path.description: Path to ISO or disk image (used when install_source is 'cdrom' or 'import')

disks.description: List of disk configuration objects for --disk option. If empty, virt-install defaults will be used or a default disk created if size is specified in items.

disks_items.description: The full argument string to pass to --disk. Example: 'size=10' or '/path/to/image.img,bus=virtio'

networks.description: List of network configuration objects for --network option. If empty, default network is used.

networks_items.description: The full argument string to pass to --network. Example: 'bridge=virbr0' or 'network=default'

graphics_type.description: Graphics type: vnc, spice, or none

graphics_listen.description: Address to listen on for VNC/Spice connections

graphics_port.description: Port to use for graphics (auto-allocate if -1)

autoconsole.description: Console mode: graphical, text, or none

libvirt_uri.description: URI for connecting to the hypervisor
